intro: I specialize in basic coding, Arduino prototyping, mechatronics, and web development using WordPress.

Over the last few years, I have developed machine learning solutions including an AI accessibility project for deaf individuals—and engineered hardware projects such as an automated water level sensing system using Arduino.
Alongside technical engineering, I bring hands-on expertise in creative media, including digital photography, videography, Photoshop, and video editing.
strengths: Applied Machine Learning for accessibility and real-world problem-solving
WordPress site development, custom management, and web services integration
End-to-end multimedia production, from photography/videography to post-processing
